title: The Forbidden Contract
summary: Ha-Jun accepts the forbidden Demon Sovereign Contract despite its dire warnings about memory loss and eternal pursuit. As his blood seals the pact, his classmate Min-Jae arrives on the devastated rooftop, witnessing the first signs that Ha-Jun is no longer human.

panels.action: The obsidian holographic contract screen hovers in the rain, purple text glowing with ominous ancient warnings.
panels.prose_en: The obsidian holographic contract screen hovers in the rain, purple text glowing with ominous ancient warnings.
panels.prose_hi: Obsidian holographic contract screen baarish mein ghum rahi hai, baingani rang ka path ashubh prachin chetavniyon ke saath chamak raha hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's index finger hovers inches away from the glowing purple [ACCEPT] prompt, raindrops dripping from his knuckle.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ek baar click kiya... toh koi wapsi nahi hogi.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's index finger hovers inches away from the glowing purple [ACCEPT] prompt, raindrops dripping from his knuckle.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki tarjani chamakdar baingani [swikar karen] prompt se kuch inch door ghum rahi hai, uske por se baarish ki bunden tapak rahi han.

panels.action: Kuro perches on Ha-Jun's shoulder, speaking in low grave tones: 'Shartein dhyan se padh lo, boy. Taqat kabhi muft nahi milti.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dhyan se padho. Sovereign ka takht qurbaniyon se banta hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro perches on Ha-Jun's shoulder, speaking in low grave tones: 'Shartein dhyan se padh lo, boy. Taqat kabhi muft nahi milti.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ha-jun ke kandhe par baithkar dheeme swar mein bolta hai: 'sharten dhyan se padh lo, ladke. taaqat kabhi muft nahin milti.'.

panels.action: The system screen scrolls: [CLAUSE 1: INSAANI KAMZORI DHEERE DHEERE MIT JAAYEGI].
panels.prose_en: The system screen scrolls: [CLAUSE 1: INSAANI KAMZORI DHEERE DHEERE MIT JAAYEGI].
panels.prose_hi: Sistm screen scroll karta hai: [khand 1: insaani kamzori dhire-dhire mit jaegi].

panels.action: The system screen scrolls: [CLAUSE 2: ABYSS KE MONSTERS AUR DEMON HUNTERS TUMHARA PEETHA KARENGE].

dialogue.text: [CLAUSE 2: TARGETED BY DEMONS AND HUNTERS ALIKE]

panels.prose_en: The system screen scrolls: [CLAUSE 2: ABYSS KE MONSTERS AUR DEMON HUNTERS TUMHARA PEETHA KARENGE].
panels.prose_hi: Sistm screen scroll karta hai: [khand 2: rasatal ke rakshas aur danav shikari tumhara peeth karenge].

panels.action: The screen flashes dark crimson: [CLAUSE 3: RELICS KI TAQAT TUMHARI PURANI YAADEIN CHEEN SAKTI HAI].
panels.prose_en: The screen flashes dark crimson: [CLAUSE 3: RELICS KI TAQAT TUMHARI PURANI YAADEIN CHEEN SAKTI HAI].
panels.prose_hi: Scrin gahre lal rang ki chamakti hai: [khand 3: avsheshon ki takat tumhari purani yaadein taja kar sakti han].

panels.action: Ha-Jun flinches, clutching his chest: 'M-Meri yaadein...? Kya main bhaiya ko bhool jaunga...?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar main bhaiya ko hi bhool gaya... toh unhe bacha kar kya karunga?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flinches, clutching his chest: 'M-Meri yaadein...? Kya main bhaiya ko bhool jaunga...?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni chhati pakadkar fadfadata hai: 'm-meri yaden...? kya main bhaiya ko bhool jaunga...?'

panels.action: Kuro: 'Sirf tab agar tum kamzor pad gaye. Agar tumhara irada lohe jaisa raha, toh tum Relics ko govern karoge.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Agar tum taqatwar bane, toh koi yaad nahi mitegi.

panels.prose_en: Kuro: 'Sirf tab agar tum kamzor pad gaye. Agar tumhara irada lohe jaisa raha, toh tum Relics ko govern karoge.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro: 'sirf tab agar tum kamazor pad gaye. agar tumhara irada lohe jaisa raha, to tum avsheshon par shasan karoge.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down at the puddle reflection—no longer seeing a victim, but someone with a burning purpose.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kamzor rehne se behtar hai... aag mein kood jaana.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks down at the puddle reflection—no longer seeing a victim, but someone with a burning purpose.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun neeche pokhar ke pratibimb ko dekhta hai - ab kisi peedit ko nahin, balki kisi jwalant uddeshya wale vyakti ko dekh raha hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun smirks with fearless conviction: 'Main tayar hoon.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smirks with fearless conviction: 'Main tayar hoon.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun nidar vishwas ke saath muskurata hai: 'main taiyar hun.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun slams his thumb firmly onto the glowing holographic [ACCEPT] button.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slams his thumb firmly onto the glowing holographic [ACCEPT] button.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun chamakte holographic [swikar karen] button par apna angutha majbuti se patakta hai.

panels.action: A crystal-clear dimensional resonance chime reverberates across the city: *PINGGGGG!!*
panels.prose_en: A crystal-clear dimensional resonance chime reverberates across the city: *PINGGGGG!!*.
panels.prose_hi: Ek cristal-spasht aayami anunaad jhankar poore shahar mein gunjati hai: *pingjijiji!!*.

panels.action: The interface UI shifts from cold obsidian into radiant royal purple and polished gold filigree.
panels.prose_en: The interface UI shifts from cold obsidian into radiant royal purple and polished gold filigree.
panels.prose_hi: Interfess ui cold obsidian se redient royal purple aur polished gold filagri mein badal jata hai.

panels.action: An intricate demonic royal crest (two crossed black wings behind a violet crown) burns into the skin of Ha-Jun's right hand.
panels.prose_en: An intricate demonic royal crest (two crossed black wings behind a violet crown) burns into the skin of Ha-Jun's right hand.
panels.prose_hi: Ek jatil rakshasi shahi shikha (bangni mukut ke peeche do paar kiye hue kale pankh) ha-jun ke dahine haath ki tvacha mein jal jaati hai.

panels.action: Kuro spreads his dark wings to their fullest span, screeching with ancient demonic ecstasy into the thunderstorm.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: ABYSS KE SULTAN KI PEHLI SEAL TOOT GAYI!!

panels.prose_en: Kuro spreads his dark wings to their fullest span, screeching with ancient demonic ecstasy into the thunderstorm.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne kale pankhon ko puri tarah se failaya hai, aur toofan mein prachin rakshasi parmanand ke saath chilla raha hai.

panels.action: A cascade of violet notification windows pops into view: [REWARD 1: BLOODLINE REGENERATION RANK F UNLOCKED].
panels.prose_en: A cascade of violet notification windows pops into view: [REWARD 1: BLOODLINE REGENERATION RANK F UNLOCKED].
panels.prose_hi: Baingani adhisuchna window ka ek jharna drishya mein aata hai: [inam 1: raktarekha punarjanan rank f unlock].

panels.action: Next window: [REWARD 2: DEMONIC PERCEPTION RANK F UNLOCKED - MANA CURRENT SIGHT ENABLED].
panels.prose_en: Next window: [REWARD 2: DEMONIC PERCEPTION RANK F UNLOCKED - MANA CURRENT SIGHT ENABLED].
panels.prose_hi: Agli vindo: [inam 2: rakshasi dharna rank f unlock - man vartmaan drishti saksham].

panels.action: Primary Quest pop-up: [MAIN QUEST: SURVIVE THE COMING SIEGE OF SAINT MIRREN].
panels.prose_en: Primary Quest pop-up: [MAIN QUEST: SURVIVE THE COMING SIEGE OF SAINT MIRREN].
panels.prose_hi: Prathmik quest pop-up: [mukhya quest: sent miren ki aane wali gherabandi se bache].

panels.action: Ha-Jun's vision shifts into infrared-violet: He can see the glowing mana pulses traveling through the campus electrical grid and ground.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Duniya... achanak aisi kyun dikh rahi hai?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's vision shifts into infrared-violet: He can see the glowing mana pulses traveling through the campus electrical grid and ground.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki drishti infraared-bangni mein badal jaati hai: wah parisar ke vidyut grid aur jameen ke madhyam se yatra karte hue chamakti man daalon ko dekh sakta hai.

panels.action: Through his new perception, Ha-Jun detects a warm human life signature climbing the staircase toward the rooftop access door.
panels.prose_en: Through his new perception, Ha-Jun detects a warm human life signature climbing the staircase toward the rooftop access door.
panels.prose_hi: Apni nai dharna ke madhyam se, ha-jun chhat ke pravesh dwar ki or sidhi chadhte hue ek garm manav jeevan hastakshar ka pata lagata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun turns swiftly toward the heavy steel rooftop door: 'Koi upar aa raha hai...!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun turns swiftly toward the heavy steel rooftop door: 'Koi upar aa raha hai...!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun teji se steel ke bhari chhat wale darvaje ki or mudta hai: 'koi upar aa raha hai...!'.

panels.action: Kuro: 'Mark chupao! Insaano ko Sovereign ka nishaan nahi dikhna chahiye!'
panels.prose_en: Kuro: 'Mark chupao! Insaano ko Sovereign ka nishaan nahi dikhna chahiye!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro: 'mark chupao! insaanon ko samprabhu ka nishan nahin dikhna chahiye!'.

panels.action: With a conscious mental command, the glowing crest fades seamlessly beneath Ha-Jun's pale skin, looking completely normal.
panels.prose_en: With a conscious mental command, the glowing crest fades seamlessly beneath Ha-Jun's pale skin, looking completely normal.
panels.prose_hi: Ek sachet mansik aadesh ke sath, chamakti shikha ha-jun ki pili tvacha ke neeche sahajta se fiki pad jaati hai, aur puri tarah se samanya dikhti hai.

panels.action: Kuro's physical form dissolves into a subtle crow silhouette inside Ha-Jun's elongated shadow on the wet ground.
panels.prose_en: Kuro's physical form dissolves into a subtle crow silhouette inside Ha-Jun's elongated shadow on the wet ground.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ka bhautik roop gili jameen par ha-jun ki lambi chhaya ke andar ek sookshm kauve ke aakaar mein vilin ho jata hai.

panels.action: The rusted industrial door pushes open with a loud metallic squeal against the rain.
panels.prose_en: The rusted industrial door pushes open with a loud metallic squeal against the rain.
panels.prose_hi: Jang laga hua audyogik darwaza baarish ke viruddh tez dhatvik cheekh ke saath khulta hai.

panels.action: Standing in the doorway is Min-Jae (17yo student, round glasses, bright yellow umbrella, dripping school uniform).

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun? Tum yahan kya kar rahe ho?

panels.prose_en: Standing in the doorway is Min-Jae (17-year-old student, round glasses, bright yellow umbrella, dripping school uniform).
panels.prose_hi: Darwaze par min-je (17 varshiya chhatra, gol chashma, chamkili pili chtari, tapakti hui school uniform) khadi hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae steps out with his umbrella: 'Class khatam huye aadha ghanta ho gaya. Maine socha tum ghar chale gaye...'
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae steps out with his umbrella: 'Class khatam huye aadha ghanta ho gaya. Maine socha tum ghar chale gaye...'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apni chhatri ke saath bahar nikalte han: 'clas khatm hue aadha ghanta ho gaya. maine socha tum ghar chale gaye...'.

panels.action: Min-Jae suddenly freezes; his gaze drops to the severed steel railings and the massive scorched impact crater in the concrete.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae suddenly freezes; his gaze drops to the severed steel railings and the massive scorched impact crater in the concrete.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je achanak thithak gaya; uski nazar kati hui steel ki railing aur concrete mein bade paimane par jhulse hue gaddhe par jaati hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae's umbrella tilts, glasses reflecting the ruined rooftop: 'Kya... un bullies ne yeh sab kiya hai?!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Kya un ladko ne tumhe maarne ke liye dynamite use kiya?!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae's umbrella tilts, glasses reflecting the ruined rooftop: 'Kya... un bullies ne yeh sab kiya hai?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ki chhatri jhuki hui hai, chashma khandhar chhat ko pratibimbit kar raha hai: 'kya... un badmashon ne yeh sab kiya hai?!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun turns around with completely calm, flawless skin and a tranquil smile: 'Nahi Min-Jae... sirf aam toofan tha.' (Cliffhanger: In the wet puddle behind him, Ha-Jun's reflection casts colossal demonic wings).

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Sirf aam toofan tha, Min-Jae. Chalo ghar chalte hain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun turns around with completely calm, flawless skin and a tranquil smile: 'Nahi Min-Jae... sirf aam toofan tha.' (Cliffhanger: In the wet puddle behind him, Ha-Jun's reflection casts colossal demonic wings).
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun puri tarah se shant, bedag tvacha aur shant muskan ke saath ghumta hai: 'nahin min-jaye... sirf aam toofan tha.' (clifahenger: uske peeche gile pokhar men, ha-jun ka pratibimb vishal rakshasi pankh failata hai).
